# TS4 Access for Mac

> Accessibility mod for The Sims 4 on macOS (fork of TS4 Access by tyjokr and LeonianUniverse), with a VoiceOver-friendly phone companion app that shows and controls the game. Read the player guide first.

## Guides

- [Player guide: phone companion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the40n8/Sims4Access-mac/main/docs/mac/PHONE-GUIDE.md): every screen, quick actions, shortcuts, troubleshooting
- [Mac install and play notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the40n8/Sims4Access-mac/main/mac/PLAYERS.md): installing, defaults, phone companion summary
- [Mac keyboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the40n8/Sims4Access-mac/main/docs/mac/KEYBOARD.md): the original mod's shortcuts with Mac keys
- [Fixed phone address](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the40n8/Sims4Access-mac/main/docs/mac/FIXED-ADDRESS.md): optional setup
- [Meeting point](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the40n8/Sims4Access-mac/main/docs/mac/MEETING-POINT.md): optional, one fixed app address that finds the Mac by itself, several Macs
- [Test checklist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the40n8/Sims4Access-mac/main/docs/mac/TESTING.md): what to try in a play session and how to report a problem
- [Fork overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the40n8/Sims4Access-mac/main/.github/README.md): what the fork is, how it is built
